{{Quote|I want something from you. You want something from me. So we try to get the other to offer it. We leave out facts to accomplish that. Have you told me all the strikes against you?|Drill instructor to Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''Individual''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and [[drill instructor]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was stationed at [[Borsk Fey'lya Army Base]] on the planet [[Vandor-3]] as a member of the [[Pop-Dogs]]. One night, he visited [[Jokko Haning's Emporium]], a bar  in [[Ackbar City]], where he struck up a conversation with [[Myri Antilles]] over drinks. Unbeknownst to him, Antilles was working undercover while posing as a [[nester]] to gather intelligence. During their conversation, he spoke about his work as a drill instructor and his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] before inadvertently revealing that he had a [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] and children. Antilles then used the revelation as an excuse to reject his advances.<ref name="MK" />
